scope: Released default Hunter configuration, parser/gates/reward callbacks and exact entity-class registration windows. Defaults are not the user or server configuration.

limits: Configuration and inter-mod messages can add Hunter registrations.
The registry uses exact entity classes; subclass inheritance is not assumed.
Duplicate classes retain their first registration in the selected method.
Attack permission, death XP and ordinary drop eligibility are distinct checks.
Portraits and dimension tags are existing scoped evidence, not live spawn guarantees.
